assessments.summary: The audited verifier establishes the stated SHA-256 digest, decoding to 152 distinct no-three-in-line points in G_76, quarter-turn invariance, exactly two dihedral images, and exactly eight distinct translated embeddings in G_77. For each embedding it exhaustively verifies the blocking and one-/two-point deletion census, including exactly 16 freeing deletion pairs. The stated bounds for nearby no-three-in-line sets follow by setting R=E\S and A=S\E and applying the verified census.
scopeQualifications: The result applies only to the eight specified embeddings.
It does not establish a property of arbitrary record configurations or determine the global value of D(77).
The declared reference is not required because the subject verifier fully rechecks all mathematical facts needed for the claim.
